annualCases.pinpoint: Example and Sample Table: taxable income at least $25,300 but less than $25,350; Single and Married filing jointly columns. Narrative explicitly directs the joint amount to Form 1040 line 16.

inputConstruction.kind: explicitly synthetic consumer fixture, not a published W-2 or complete return
inputConstruction.rule: Use the published filing status and $25,300 taxable income. Construct W-2 box 1 as $25,300 plus the published basic standard deduction. Choose under-65, nonblind filers with no dependent claim, no other income, no adjustments, no itemized deductions and no credits to isolate the printed tax-table result. Withholding is a synthetic zero required by the W-2 schema and is not an expected refund/owed assertion.

Do not invent missing eligibility or alter the source to produce a passing full-return fixture.
